name: MsoCTPDockPositionRestrict
description: Specifies restrictions on the docking behavior of the custom task pane.

constants.name: msoCTPDockPositionRestrictNone
constants.description: No restrictions on docking the task pane.

constants.name: msoCTPDockPositionRestrictNoChange
constants.description: There is no change from the current restriction setting for the task pane.

constants.name: msoCTPDockPositionRestrictNoHorizontal
constants.description: Task pane can't be docked to either the right or the left side of the document window.

constants.name: msoCTPDockPositionRestrictNoVertical
constants.description: Task pane can't be docked to either the top or the bottom of the document window.
